name: GGz
subtitle: Gaming News and Deals
description: GGz is a gaming discovery and tracking app that helps players find what to play, when to buy, and what they already have access to. Discover new and upcoming games, trending and highly rated titles, compare prices and deals, track Game Pass, PlayStation Plus, EA Play, Ubisoft+ and Prime Gaming catalogs, and never miss free games or important gaming news. Save games to your backlog and wishlist, follow releases and franchises, and get personalized notifications. Built with Titanium, GGz brings games, subscriptions, deals and gaming news together in one place.
